uncertainties.note: Vent Roll (ベントロール) and VRF (ＶＲＦ) are ship/part designations for the Gekko-class vessel taking damage. No reliable English source confirming 'Vent Roll' was found (Eureka Seven wiki searches returned only the Gekko's general Trapar-based flight description); VRF is kept as a bare, already-Roman-letter abbreviation. Both proposed as provisional terms in batch_10387_glossary_proposals.json pending a better source.

Speaker is not named in these rows, but the addressee's reply 'Sakuya...' (dialogue_10430) and the content (a past failed attempt to cross into the Zone 'as a paired one', now passed on to 'those kids') match the glossary's Sakuya profile ('Eureka's predecessor... in love with Norb'). No name was inserted into dialogue_10425-10429 themselves; the identification is inference from context, not an assertion added to the text.

対の者 rendered as 'the paired ones', a descriptive translation of the Vodarac pairing concept (Sakuya bonded with a human partner, per Eureka Seven Wiki's Humanoid Coralians/Norb pages) rather than an established fixed English term; no glossary entry exists for this phrase. Flagged as a term proposal.

'Tower' (タワー) is used as a ship name in this scene (it can be 'abandoned' like a vessel, alongside the Gekko/Nadesico/Izumo). This exact spelling already appears in work/translation/en/encyclopedia_022.json for the same katakana string, but that entry's own series/backstory context could not be confirmed (its neighboring entries mix Getter Robo Armageddon and King Gainer terms, likely just adjacent table slots rather than a thematic grouping). Spelling reused for consistency; identity beyond 'one of the escorted motherships' is not asserted.

'Harry' assumed to be the previously researched nickname for Ruri Hoshino's aide (see glossary proposals_dialogue_00776.json), consistent with a Nadesico-crew giving orders about escort/protective units; not independently reconfirmed as this specific character within this scene.
